newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan overnight rates ease to 6.50-7.50 pct.
newsitem.headline: Jordan overnight rates ease to 6.50-7.50 pct.

text.p: Overnight rates on the Jordanian dinar eased to 6.50-7.50 percent on Wednesday from 7.00-8.25 percent on Tuesday with an oversupply of dinars weighing down on rates, dealers said.
"There is heavy supply with no real demand," one dealer said.
Dealers said the market has become more noticeably liquid since the start of weekly trade on Saturday. Levels have fallen below a 9 percent average last week.
